name: BAW931 [乘客重病，让路，发动机起火]

cards.audioText: 1N: You are BAW931, at stand 709, with information L, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是英航931，在709号机位，收到通播Lima，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan delivery, BAW931, information L received, stand 709, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航931，收到通播Lima，709号机位，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。

cards.audioText: 2C: Clear to London, via flight planned route. ZF05D departure, initially climb to 1500 m, cruising level 10,700 m, runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，ZF05D离场，初始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场后联系124.7，应答机4503。
cards.referenceText: Clear to London via flight planned route. ZF05D departure, initially climb to 1500 m, cruising level 10,700 m. runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，ZF05D离场，初始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场后联系124.7，应答机4503，英航931。

cards.audioText: 3N: Now you are ready for push-back and start up, contact ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好推出开车了，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航931，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: 4C: BAW931, Push back and start up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，可以推出开车，朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north. BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，朝北，英航931。

cards.audioText: 5N: Now you have a problem. One of your passenger is seriously ill. You inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger. You have to delay the push-back due to disembarking the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: N：你现在遇到了一个问题，一名乘客病得很重，告知管制员，请求让这名乘客下飞机。由于乘客要下飞机，所以你推迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, request delay push-back and disembark an ill passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航931，请求推迟推出，让生病乘客下飞机。

cards.audioText: 6N: This time, contact your company to inform this situation. And also request medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 这次，联系你们公司，告知此情况，同时申请医疗协助。
cards.referenceText: Company office(此处可以是Operation office或者dispatcher), BAW931, push-back is delayed due to ill passenger, request medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 公司，英航931，由于一名得病乘客，推迟推出，请求医疗协助。

cards.audioText: 7N: Now, you have disembarked this passenger. Request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，这名乘客已经下机，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan ground, BAW931, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航931，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: 8C: BAW931, taxi to the Holding point of runway 18L via A7, A, hold short of A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，经由A7，A滑行道跑道18左外等待点，在A5等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to the holding point of runway 18L, via A7, A, hold short of A5, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由A7，A滑行道跑道18左外等待点，在A5等待，英航931。

cards.audioText: 9N: There is a B777 of your company behind you, Give way to the A320 crossing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: 你后方有一架本公司的波音777，给正在从左向右穿越的空客A320让路。
cards.referenceText: 9P: Give way to the A320, BAW931.

cards.audioText: 10C: BAW931, continue taxi after traffic is cleared, hold short of runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，冲突接触后继续滑行，在跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi after traffic is cleared, hold short of runway 18L. BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冲突接触后继续滑行，在跑道18左外等待，英航931。

cards.audioText: 11C: BAW931, Line up and wait, clear for takeoff 18L, wind calm. Contact departure 124.5 after airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，上跑道等待，可以起飞，跑道18左，静风。离地后联系124.5。（注意，实际运行中，上跑道与起飞许可不会同时发布，这里是原题反馈，学员注意按题干要求复诵即可）
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, 124.5, clear for takeoff, runway 18L, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道等待，124.5，可以起飞，跑道18左，英航931。

cards.audioText: 12N: During take off rolling, your right engine suddenly got fire. You have to abort takeoff, contact ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑跑期间，你右发突然着火。 你必须中断起飞，联系管制员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW931, abort takeoff due to right engine fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航931，右发起火，中断起飞了。

cards.audioText: 13N: The fire can not be extinguished. Inform this to ATC. Also you want to carry out evacuation, and request emergency equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: 火无法熄灭，告知管制员此情况。同时，你想执行应急撤离，请求应急设备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW931, We can’t extinguish the fire, request emergency evacuation and emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航931，火无法熄灭，请求应急撤离和应急设备。
